verdict.rationale: Typesense's own docs say it is optimized for instant, typically sub-50ms search-as-you-type, which is exactly this story. The homepage demo reports millisecond query times over 2.2M records, and community users praise its instant search queries and see it as a good fit for instant-search behavior. Missing for 10: independent hands-on latency benchmarks confirming per-keystroke millisecond responses at scale; the only community demo report concerns a UI empty-state bug, not latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deliver as-you-type instant search with millisecond responses so results update on every keystroke

citations.quote: Typesense is an open-source, typo-tolerant search engine optimized for instant (typically sub-50ms) search-as-you-type experiences and developer productivity.
Love the instant search queries and the fuzzy text matching.
